name: e2ee-chat-app
description: Production-ready End-to-End Encrypted (E2EE) and Local-Encrypted Real-Time Chat App with Three.js & Vengeance UI

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
